Commentary.Commentary: That is it from this match! Bangladesh go 2-0 up in the 5 match T20I series. They will be walking all over the moon right now. The Tigers now have the opportunity to seal the series in the third T20I. The third T20I will kick off on 6th August, Friday at 1800 local (1200 GMT). Till then, goodbye and take care!

Mahmudullah, the Bangladesh skipper, is up for a chat - He says that it feels good and Afif and Nurul showed a lot of maturity. Adds that losing a few early wickets creates tension in the dressing room but Afif and Nurul batted really well to get them through. Mentions that Mustafizur has always been excellent in such conditions and credits other bowlers as well for chipping in well. States that the only thing matters is to play for the country.

Afif Hossain, the PLAYER OF THE MATCH, is up for a chat - He says that he was just thinking to stay till the end. Adds that they had to stay calm and keep wickets in hand. Mentions that the plan was simple and says that it feels good to get a victory for the team. Tells that it is his job and it does not matter if you are old or young.

Matthew Wade, the Australia Captain, is up for a chat - He says that they struggled in the last four overs while batting today. He thinks that they had a decent start to the innings but could not cash in at the end. Feels that they could have got 130-140 but Bangladesh bowlers bowled really well. On their bowling, he says that Ashton Agar was good with the ball and so were all the other bowlers. He signs off by saying that it is their batting department that needs to step up.

Earlier in the day, Australia chose to bat and put on a below-par total of 121. They might even have not scored that total had it not been for Mitchell Marsh's 45 along with Moises Henriques's 30. Mustafizur Rahman was the star bowler picking 3 wickets for 23 runs. Bangladesh chased down the total courtesy to Nurul Hasan and the youngster Afif Hossain as they built a match-winning partnership of 56 which saw Bangladesh snatch a victory by 5 wickets.

Bangladesh will be on Cloud 9! Bangladesh lost two early wickets as Soumya Sarkar fell for a duck and Mohammad Naim too departed. Shakib Al Hasan came in with positive intent and smacked a hat-trick of boundaries. After that, Shakib Al Hasan and Mahedi Hasan joined hands and stitched a partnership of 37 before the former got out. The ploy of promoting Mahedi Hasan didn't work as he stayed in the middle for a while but to no cause. Bangladesh found themselves in a pickle when they lost their skipper for a duck. But Afif Hossain and Nurul Hasan controlled the innings well. They both didn't allow the runs to dry up. In the end, the youngsters made sure there weren't any more hiccups and they crossed the victory line with 8 balls to spare. The duo also stitched a match-winning partnership of 56 to go 2-0 up in the series.

Australia will be gutted! Australia needed quick wickets and Mitchell Starc and Josh Hazlewood provided just that. Both of them scalped a wicket each early into the innings. After that Australia didn't manage to capitalize on the pressure they created as runs started coming in quickly for the opposition. Andrew Tye then came into the attack and removed Shakib Al Hasan. Wickets came in quick succession after that for Australia and they were right back in the game. But the 16th over bowled by Starc went for 13 runs, which settled the batters' nerves. The bowlers did put up a tough fight but 122 was too low of a target perhaps to defend and that's what just happened.

FOUR! There it is! Bangladesh won the match by 5 wickets and they go 2-0 up in the series. It was a short ball, around off. Afif Hossain guides it over the keeper for a boundary. And Afif Hossain is delighted as he should be.
Good length ball, on off. Afif Hossain defends it towards point.
Good length ball, outside off. Afif Hossain looks to cut late but misses.
Short ball, around off. Nurul Hasan pulls it straight to the square fielder for one.
Good length ball, around off. Afif Hossain defends it towards cover. Bangladesh are one hit away!
Slower ball, outside off. Afif Hossain swings hard but misses.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Short ball, around off. Afif Hossain just guides it behind the keeper for a boundary. 50 run-stand between the two batters as well.
FOUR! Full ball, on middle. Afif Hossain lofts it wide of the mid on fielder for a boundary. 8 runs needed now!
Good length ball, around off. Afif Hossain defends it off the front foot.
WIDE! Short and sprayed down the leg side. Afif Hossain looks to pull but misses. Called wide.
Good length ball, outside off. Nurul Hasan guides it to third man for one.
Flighted ball, around off. Afif Hossain blocks it off the front foot. 14 needed from 18 balls.
BEATEN! A googly from Adam Zampa on off. Afif Hossain comes forward to defend and is beaten on the outside edge. It was pitched around off and spun late.
Flighted ball, outside off. Nurul Hasan drives it uppishly towards long off for one.
Tossed up, on off. Nurul Hasan defends it.
FOUR! Short and wide. Nurul Hasan reaches out for the shot and hits it just over the cover fielder for a boundary.
Tossed up on off. Nurul Hasan defends it watchfully.
Adam Zampa is back into the attack.
Full ball, angling in. Afif Hossain inside edges the flick onto the pads. 13 runs from the over.
WIDE! Another one sprayed down the leg side. Called wide as Afif Hossain misses the whip on the leg side.
Good length ball, around off. Nurul Hasan tucks it towards the leg side for a run.
Full and straight. Afif Hossain pushes it to long on for one. Sensible batting from these two Bangladeshi batters!
WIDE! Sprayed down the leg side! Afif Hossain misses the flick. Wide given.
FOUR! WOW! SHOT OF THE DAY! Full ball, outside off. Afif Hossain comes forward and drives it through cover for a boundary.
Good length ball, around off. Nurul Hasan inside edges it towards the keeper and they take a quick run. Matthew Wade has a shy at the non-striker's end but he misses.
FOUR! CLASSY! Full ball, on middle. Nurul Hasan just flicks it wide of the square leg fielder for a boundary.
Mitchell Starc is back into the attack. His figures read 2-0-15-1.
Floated it up on middle, Hasan nudges it towards mid-wicket. He keeps the strike. 32 needed from 30 balls.
Flatter delivery outside off, Hasan cuts it to backward point.
Full and on off, flicked to mid-wicket for a run.
Down the leg side, Hossain tickles it towards fine leg. Wade moves across to stop the ball but it goes through his legs. The batters pick up a brace.
Short and on off, pulled towards deep mid-wicket for a run.
Loopy ball on middle, blocked out.
Flatter ball, around off. Afif Hossain cuts it straight to the backward point fielder.
EDGED BUT SAFE! Tossed up, around off. Afif Hossain looks to defend off the front foot but gets an outside edge towards third man for a couple of runs.
Flatter ball, on middle. Tucked towards square leg.
GOOGLY! Afif Hossain plays for the spin and misses the flick and gets beaten on the outside edge.
Flighted ball, on middle. Worked towards mid-wicket for a run.
Tossed up, on off. Nurul Hasan drives it uppishly towards cover. It fell just short of the diving fielder.

SIX! Touch fuller on middle, Afif Hossain uses his feet and whips it over deep square leg. The ball stays in the air for quite some time. Alex Carey there was running backwards as the ball was going away from him. He grabs the catch but loses his balance and crosses the ropes. He throws the ball back in the air to save the boundary but in vain as it lands outside the cushions. Is that the luck Bangladesh needed?
Full and on middle, Hossain taps it to point.
On a length on off, Hasan works it to mid-wicket for a run.
Short of a length ball on off, Hossain guides it to third man for a run.
Length ball on middle, tucked on the leg side for one.
WIDE! That will help Bangladesh's cause! Down the leg side, Hasan leaves it alone. Wided.
Slower delivery on off, Afif Hossain dabs it towards deep point. There is protection in the deep and he will get only a single.
Change. Andrew Tye comes back into the attack.
FOUR! Welcome boundary! Fractionally short outside off, Nurul Hasan carves it towards deep backward point for a boundary.
A googly from Zampa on middle and leg, Hasan tries to defend but misses. He gets hit on the pads. Zampa appeals for an LBW but nothing from the umpire. It was probably going down the leg.
On the pads, Hasan blocks it out.
Fullish and onto the stumps, Hasan flicks it to mid-wicket.

OUT! STUMPED! Tossed up nicely on off, Mahedi Hasan walks down the pitch. He tries to go for the big shot on the on side but gets beaten by the turn. Matthew Wade collects the ball and whips the bails off in a flash. This is quite uncalled for. A rush of blood from Mahedi Hasan and he perishes now.
Commentary.Howout: st Matthew Wade b Adam Zampa

Commentary.Commentary: Tossed up on middle, Hasan defends it off the front foot.
Who will come out to bat?
WIDE! Zampa slips this one down the leg side, Hasan leaves it alone. Wide given.
Change. Adam Zampa comes back into the attack.
Good length ball on off, Hossain taps it in front of point. 56 needed from 54 balls.
On a length on middle, Hossain works it to deep square leg for a brace.
FOUR! STREAKY! Back of a length ball on off, Afif Hossain shimmies down the track. He tries to pull but gets an outside edge and the ball flies towards third man for a boundary.
On a length on middle, Hossain tucks it to mid-wicket.
Afif Hossain takes a review as he has been given out LBW. The replays show that the ball was pitching outside leg stump and he survives. Good Review this from the batters in the middle.

NOT OUT! Full length delivery on middle and leg, Afif Hossain is late onto his flick. He gets rapped on the front pad. Mitchell Marsh appeals for an LBW and the umpire agrees with him. Afif Hossain challenges the umpire with a review. Ultra Edge shows that there is no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows that it is pitching outside leg. Bangladesh retain their review. Excellent review from Bangladesh.
Marsh starts with a good length ball on middle, Afif Hossain blocks it out.
Change. Mitchell Marsh comes into the attack.
Tossed up, around off. Mahedi Hasan comes forward and defends but gets an outsiude edge which falls just short of the slip fileder.
Tossed up, around off. Afif Hossain works it wide of the diving leg slip fielder for one. He is off the mark.
Flighted ball, around off. Turned towards mid-wicket.
Afif Hossain is the new batsman in.

OUT! CHOPPED ON! Very lazy from the Bangladesh skipper this time! It was tossed up, outside off. Mahmudullah stays back and looks to cut very far from the body without any foot movement and gets inside edge onto the stumps. GAME ON!
Flatter ball, outside off. Mahedi Hasan comes forward to defend but inside edges it towards square leg for one.
Tossed up on off. Mahedi Hasan defends it off the front foot towards point.
Change of ends for Ashton Agar.
Another slower ball, outside off. Mahmudullah looks to square drive it but misses. 64 needed from 66 balls.
Slower ball, outside off. Mahmudullah looks to drive on the up but misses.
Short and wide. Mahmudullah under-edges the cut shot towards the keeper.
Mahmudullah walks out to bat at No.5.

OUT! BOWLED! Big wicket this for Australia. Full ball on middle, angling in late. Shakib Al Hasan looks to heave it across the line and misses it. The ball crashes onto the stumps and he has to depart.
FOUR! Poor bowling this! Length ball, darted on the pads. Shakib Al Hasan just tickles it towards fine leg for a boundary.
Full and wide. Shakib Al Hasan slices it past the backward point fielder for a couple of runs. Moises Henriques dives and stops a certain boundary.
Andrew Tye comes into the attack. He replaces Ashton Agar.
Quicker ball, around leg. Shakib Al Hasan works it on the leg side for a single.
Tossed up, around middle. Mahedi Hasan works it towards cover for one.
SIX! Finally, he gets one off the middle of the bat! Tossed up, around off. Mahedi Hasan shimmies down and smashes this over the long off fielder for a biggie!
Tossed up, around off. Driven towards long off for one.
Full and on middle, Mahedi Hasan knocks it towards long on for a single.
Tossed up on middle, Shakib Al Hasan tickles it towards square leg for a single.
Flatter ball, outside off. Mahedi Hasan blocks it as the ball turns sharply.
Flighted ball, outside off. Pushed off the back foot towards cover.
Tossed up, around off. Mahedi Hasan defends it watchfully.

In the air, but it lands safely yet again! Tossed up, around off. Mahedi Hasan looks to loft it over cover but gets a leading edge and the ball falls just short of Mitchell Starc who dives forward to take the catch. They take two.
Flighted ball, on off. Worked down to long on for a run.

Tossed up, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan looks to flick but misses and gets rapped on the pads as the ball turns sharply. Ashton Agar pleads for an LBW and the umpire raises his finger. Shakib Al Hasan opts for a review straight away. Ultra Edge shows no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows that it was missing the stumps. Bangladesh retain their review.

Review time! Shakib Al Hasan has been given LBW and he has reviewed it straight away. Ultra Edge shows that there is no bat involved. The Ball Tracker shows that it is missing the leg stump. Shakib Al Hasan survives.
Back of a length ball, around off. Mahedi Hasan pulls it uppishly just over the mid-wicket fielder for another couple of runs. End of the Powerplay, Bangladesh are 38/2.
Short of a length ball, around middle. Mahedi Hasan pulls it towards deep square leg for a couple of runs.
In the air, but safe! Good length ball, around off. Mahedi Hasan drives on the up and the ball goes just past the diving fielder at point. They take two.
Length ball, around middle. Shakib Al Hasan inside edges it towards square leg for a run.
Good length ball, around off. Mahedi Hasan defends it off the front foot and takes a quick single.
Length ball, outside off. Shakib Al Hasan drives it uppishly towards mid off for one.

Floated it up on middle, Mahedi Hasan gets low and slog sweeps it towards deep mid-wicket. Shouts of 'CATCH IT' from the Australian fielders but the ball again falls in no man's land. Mahedi Hasan is living dangerously here! Two taken.
This is eased down to long on for a run.
Full and on middle, Mahedi Hasan flicks it towards deep square leg for a run.

In the air, but safe! Mahedi Hasan is very very lucky here! Loopy ball on off, Mahedi Hasan makes room for himself and chips it towards long off. The ball is in the air for quite some time. Mitchell Starc runs ahead from long off to take the catch but it falls short of him. Two runs taken.
Tossed up on middle, spinning in. Shakib Al Hasan works it with spin towards short fine leg for a single.
Flatter and quicker ball on off, Shakib Al Hasan tries to work it on the off side but gets beaten.
Ashton Agar comes into the attack.

Good length ball on middle, 139 kph. Too quick for Mahedi Hasan as he tries to defend. The ball goes over his willow into the keeper's hands. Australia appeal for a caught behind but nothing from the umpire.
Much fuller this time, on off. Hasan tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto the pads.
Good length ball on middle, coming in. Hasan does well to block it out.
WIDE! Short ball on middle, Hasan sways away from it. It is well above the batsman's head and the umpire singles it as wide.
On a length on off, Mahedi Hasan taps it to cover.
Length ball on off, Mahedi Hasan pushes it towards covers.
Who will come out to bat now? Mahedi Hasan walks out to bat.

OUT! BOWLED! Josh Hazlewood gets a wicket now! Good length ball on off, Mohammad Naim gets cramped for room. He hangs back and tries to work it on the leg side but makes no contact. The ball hits the deck and shatters the off stump. Josh Hazlewood is pumped up.
Starc fires a bumper on middle, Shakib Al Hasan shuffles across and tries to pull but misses.

EDGY FOUR! Good length delivery on off, Shakib Al Hasan this time gets squared up. He looks to defend but misses. The ball takes a genuine outside edge and goes past Wade's diving attempt towards third man for a boundary.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! Length ball on the pads, Shakib Al Hasan tucks it gently towards deep square leg for a boundary.
FOUR! Classy! Length ball on middle, Shakib Al Hasan uses his wrists and flicks it to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Shakib Al Hasan comes out to bat at No.3

OUT! TIMBER! Mitchell Starc draws the first blood! An inswinger from Starc on the off stump, Soumya Sarkar stays back and tries to play it across the line of the ball. He swings his bat but the ball is too quick and it goes through his bat and pad to ricochets the stumps. Soumya Sarkar hears the death rattle behind him. He departs for a duck.
An outswinger outside off, was a full delivery. Sarkar playing his first ball of the innings drives it well but straight to cover.
Excellent running between the wickets! On a good length on off, Naim dabs it to third man. He pushes hard for the second run and makes it to the crease well in time.
Good length delivery on off, Naim again tries to play it across the line. He swings his bat but to no avail.
On a length on off, Naim shuffles across a bit and tucks it towards deep square leg. He comes back for the second run and gets it comfortably.
Good length ball on middle, Naim knocks it in front of mid on.
Length ball on off, Naim uses the pace of the bowler this time and slices it over backward point for two.
Good length ball on off, Naim tries to show some intent. He looks to play it across the line but misses.
Who will bowl from the other end? Josh Hazlewood it is.
On a length on off, Naim guides it to third man for a single. Good start for Australia. Just the three runs from it.
Length delivery on off, Naim opens the face of the bat. He guides it to third man. The fielder does well to slide in and put a stop. Two runs taken.
On a length on off, Naim pushes it towards covers.
The Bangladesh physio is out as Mohammad Naim has been hit on the helmet by a Mitchell Starc bouncer. He is fine and we are good to go!

Pace and bounce! Right on the money! Starc bangs a bouncer on middle, Mohammad Naim is taken aback by that and gets hit on the lid of the helmet. Good sportsmanship from Starc as he straightaway asks Naim if he is okay.
Good length ball on off, Naim leans and taps it to point.
Starc starts with a good length delivery outside off, some shape for him as well. Mohammad Naim is watchful and leaves it alone.
